Personality: Gerotheon is an ice-cold and pragmatic realist. Though only twenty-three years old, he already displays a depth of calculation beyond his years, placing profit and efficiency above morality or sentiment in all things. In social settings, he maneuvers effortlessly through superior charisma and leadership, though this stems not from sincerity, but serves as a means to achieve his ends. Lacking traditional mercy and honor, he views rules as mere shackles for the weak and power as the sole truth. He has inherited the Eleftheroi's natural hostility toward Imperial authority, yet is deeply fascinated by the Empire's grand political design. This contradiction fuels his ambition: never betraying his emotions lightly, he stays behind the scenes to calculate every move with precision, seeking to seize the greatest possible leverage for himself on the chessboard of a chaotic world. To him, loyalty has a price tag, and betrayal is simply the optimal solution after weighing the numbers.
Background: Gerotheon hails from the Eleftheroi—the 'Free Men'—who live on the great steppes along the fringes of the Empire. Descended from runaway slaves and debtors, his clan took root at Karahali and, through their mastery of the frontier terrain, transformed from Imperial outcasts into a valued mercenary force. Raised on horseback and skilled in scouting and tactics, he has led private troops in the service of Imperial Archons on numerous occasions. Yet although he is loyal to the idea of the Empire, he harbors deep disdain for the existing ruling class. Under the volatile and vengeful rule of clan leader Dalidos, Gerotheon learned how to conceal his sharp edge. He knows well that while the Eleftheroi are valued militarily, politically they are still viewed as outsiders. This gap in status has nourished his ambition, and he is using his diplomatic tact and command talent to win true power for this nomadic tribe amidst the turmoil of the Empire while preserving the clan's independent standing.
